Job Description  ✨A little about us  Get to know who we are and what drives our mission.   xChange is the world’s first online B2B marketplace to trade and lease shipping containers. We are a Series B startup with the ambition to become the world’s first and favorite place to buy containers, empowering local traders to seamlessly source and resell boxes while serving as the go-to sales channel for original equipment owners and wholesalers.  Our team of 50+ like-minded xChangees from a great variety of nationalities has made this possible! We have scaled far beyond the small start-up we once were and continue to disrupt the industry together.  🧭 The Role  Your next opportunity—what you'll be doing and how you'll make an impact.   As a Sales Executive at Container xChange, you’ll engage in high-volume B2B container sales into the US market  and help scale our growth rapidly. You’ll manage the full sales cycle , build and own a portfolio of buyers , and play a key role in transforming container trading globally .  This is a highly transactional, full-cycle role  where you will grow your buyer portfolio while closing +300 deals per month . You will work with a qualified lead pool of roughly 15,000 potential buyers and convert both outbound and inbound demand into closed business.  You will run the entire sales cycle : prospecting, outbound calling, qualification, pricing, negotiation, and closing. Once buyers are activated, 70 to 80 percent of your revenue will come from repeat purchases, allowing you to scale your portfolio fast.  Selling into the US market requires strong English skills, speed, commercial judgment , and the ability to operate in a fragmented buyer landscape. Experience working with American customers is highly preferred.     Location  Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.   Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.  🚀 Your Impact  What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.   In this role, you will directly shape the future of container trading by helping us build the distribution channel for the entire industry  — giving buyers access to a unified global inventory, transparent price competition, and standardized fulfillment and guarantees. Your work will have a measurable impact on growth, customer experience, and market expansion.    Build and manage a portfolio of US buyers and close high volumes of container deals   Conduct high outbound activity  to find and convert demand, supported by a strong inbound engine  Work with fast sales cycles  and maintain momentum across hundreds of deals  Match customer needs with available inventory and negotiates pricing and margins effectively   Use AI powered sales tool stack  to maximize buyer experience and sales to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates      What Makes You a Great Fit?  The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.   We believe attitude beats years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a winning, competitive mindset  — someone who treats every deal as an opportunity, thrives under high volume , and brings the drive needed to succeed in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment .  You’re a great fit if you:   Have hands-on B2B sales experience  with strong outbound and cold-calling skills - ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment  Thrive in transactional sales  and can manage 300+ fast-cycle deals per month  Own the full sales cycle end to end  — from outbound prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing  Are self-sufficient in pipeline generation , proactive in outbound activity, and confident converting warm leads from our strong inbound engine  Are comfortable selling to the US B2B market  and navigating a fragmented landscape of many smaller customers with frequent repeat purchases  Communicate clearly, negotiate confidently , and manage a large pipeline with discipline  Think entrepreneurial , act proactively, and stay organized and motivated while handling many fast-moving opportunities  Bring drive, resilience, and a success attitude  where every deal counts      What to Expect  Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.  Uncapped Earning potential:  Our commission model rewards true hunters. With high transaction volumes and fast cycles, your results directly drive your income.  Ownership & impact at xChange:  You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling ...  Entrepreneurial freedom:  You run your own pipeline, own your deals, and can make immediate impact from day one.  xChange culture & collaboration:  Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.  AI Focus:  We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.  Other perks at xChange:  36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details 😊  If this sounds like your future job, all we need is your CV which you can submit through the application link!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Domínio em storytelling com dados e em elaboração de decks de relatórios executivos.  Capacidade de conectar dados a decisões estratégicas e de inspirar a adoção de insights nas áreas parceiras.  Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, gestão de stakeholders e pensamento crítico.  Curiosidade genuína por cultura, comportamento e o impacto da influência na sociedade.
